runtime_mode: native; lazy attach, auto launch disabled

tools.name: feature_sweep
tools.title: Sweep (boss or cut)
tools.description: Sweep / swept boss or cut / spring / tube: moves a closed profile sketch (or a circle of circularProfileDiameterMm) along a path; the profile must sit at the path start (feature_helix returns startMm). Verified: a Sweep without errors, the volume changed, and an unmerged sweep has profile area x path length; otherwise rolled back.

path.description: Path: a sketch, an edge, or a curve such as Helix/Spiral1 (by name).

circularProfileDiameterMm.description: Circle diameter in mm, instead of a profile.

guides.description: Guide curves that shape the section (sketches, edges, curves).

cut.description: Cut material instead of adding it.

twistDeg.description: Twist along the path in degrees.

merge.description: Merge the result with existing bodies (boss).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_loft
tools.title: Loft (boss or cut)
tools.description: Loft / blend / transition through closed profiles in order (sketches on separate planes, or faces), optionally with guide curves; cut=true removes material. Verified: a loft without errors, the volume changed, and its faces pass through every profile; otherwise rolled back.

profiles.description: Profiles in loft order: sketches (by name) or faces.

guides.description: Guide curves that shape the section (sketches, edges, curves).

cut.description: Cut material instead of adding it.

closed.description: Close the loft from the last profile back to the first (3+ profiles).

merge.description: Merge the result with existing bodies (boss).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_helix
tools.title: Helix / spiral
tools.description: Helix / spiral curve (springs, threads, coils) from a sketch with one circle (center, radius); it climbs along the sketch normal. Verified: a Helix starting on the circle with the requested height, pitch and length. Returns startMm and profilePlaneNormal: put a sweep profile on that plane through startMm.

pitchMm.description: Pitch per turn in mm (spiral: the gap between turns).

sketch.description: Sketch with the circle (default: the open sketch, else the last finished one).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_draft
tools.title: Draft faces
tools.description: Draft / taper faces (mold release) by an angle about a neutral plane or planar face. Verified: a Draft without errors, the volume changed, and each planar face turned by angleDeg about its line on the neutral plane; otherwise rolled back.

faces.description: Faces to draft, e.g. the side walls.

neutral.description: Neutral plane or planar face, e.g. the bottom face.

flip.description: Draft the other way (reverse the pull direction).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_rib
tools.title: Rib
tools.description: Rib / gusset / stiffener from an open sketch (usually a line between walls), thickened and extended to the part. Verified: a Rib without errors, material added, side faces thicknessMm apart about the sketch; otherwise rolled back (a side that meets no wall is retried flipped).

sketch.description: Rib sketch (default: the open sketch, else the last finished one).

bothSides.description: Thickness centered on the sketch (else on one side).

flipMaterial.description: Extend the material to the other side of the sketch.

normalToSketch.description: Extrude normal to the sketch plane instead of parallel to it.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_thread_cosmetic
tools.title: Cosmetic thread
tools.description: Cosmetic thread annotation (no geometry) on the circular edge of a hole or shaft, e.g. for tapped holes; size M6 gives a hole the major, a shaft the minor diameter. Verified: a CosmeticThread whose diameter and depth read back; otherwise rolled back.

edge.description: Circular edge where the thread starts, e.g. a hole rim.

size.description: Metric size M6 or M6x0.75 (sets the diameter).

diameterMm.description: Thread diameter in mm (instead of size).

throughAll.description: Thread the whole length instead of depthMm.

standard.description: none (default: the diameter as given) | ansi_metric | iso | ansi_inch | din | jis; a standard needs size.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: asm_insert
tools.title: Insert component
tools.description: Insert / add a component (part or subassembly) with its origin at originMm and an optional rotation about it. SOLIDWORKS fixes the first component (reported; fixed=false floats it). Verified: one more component and the placement read back (origin within 1 µm, axes), else removed. Returns its name (bracket-1), origin, rotation, box, fixed.

path.description: A saved .sldprt/.sldasm (relative: the output folder), or an open saved document (handle D2 or title).

originMm.description: Where the component's origin goes, [x,y,z] assembly mm (default [0,0,0]).

rotation.description: {axis:[x,y,z], angleDeg}: right-hand rotation about the component origin.

angleDeg.description: Degrees, right-hand rule about the axis.

pointMm.description: Move only: a point on the axis, mm (default: the component origin).

configuration.description: Configuration of the file to use (default: its active one).

fixed.description: true fixes, false floats; default: SOLIDWORKS' choice.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the result even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Assembly (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: asm_mate_add
tools.title: Add mate
tools.description: Mate / constrain components. a and b are in different components: planes {component:'base-1', name:'top'}; faces {component:'pin-1', at:[x,y,z]} in that part's mm (type edge|vertex for those); lock: {name:'base-1'}. Also limit distance/angle (minMm/maxMm, minDeg/maxDeg), symmetric (plane), width (a, b width faces; c, d tab faces), hinge (a, b round; c, d planar), gear (ratio), rack_pinion (pitchMm; a = the rack's straight edge). Verified: a new mate without errors and the solved geometry (or the gear/rack numbers) read back, else deleted and the components moved back.

type.description: coincident | concentric | parallel | perpendicular | tangent | distance | angle | lock | symmetric | width | hinge | gear | rack_pinion

b.description: Second entity (another component, or an assembly plane {name:'top'}).

c.description: width: first tab face; hinge: first coincident face.

d.description: width: second tab face; hinge: second coincident face.

alignment.description: closest | aligned | anti_aligned (normals/axes same or opposite).

flip.description: Flip to the other side (gear, rack: reverse the direction).

minMm.description: distance: limit mate minimum in mm (with maxMm).

maxMm.description: distance: limit mate maximum in mm.

minDeg.description: angle: limit mate minimum in degrees (with maxDeg).

maxDeg.description: angle: limit mate maximum in degrees.

pitchMm.description: rack_pinion: rack travel per pinion turn in mm (π × pitch diameter).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the result even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Assembly (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: asm_mate_list
tools.title: List mates
tools.description: List the assembly's mates: name, type, alignment, entity kinds and components, distance/angle with its dimension name (dimension_set drives it), error and suppressed state.

doc.description: Assembly (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: asm_component_list
tools.title: List components
tools.description: List components: name, path, configuration, fixed, suppression (resolved | lightweight | suppressed), visible, placement (originMm; rotation rows: assembly = R·part + origin), assembly box, constrained status, mate count, children.

doc.description: Assembly (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: asm_component_set
tools.title: Set component state
tools.description: Fix or float, suppress or unsuppress, resolve or make lightweight, hide or show a component, or switch its configuration. Each change is read back (all reverted if one fails); returns the previous values and the new state.

fixed.description: true fixes it in place, false floats it.

resolved.description: true loads a lightweight component fully, false makes it lightweight.

configuration.description: Configuration of the component's file to use.

doc.description: Assembly (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: asm_component_move
tools.title: Move component
tools.description: Move / rotate a floating component (its transform): translateMm and/or rotation about pointMm (default: its origin); absolute=true makes them the new origin and orientation. Fixed components are refused (float them first). Verified: the placement read back. Its mates pull it back at the next rebuild (warned).

rotation.description: {axis:[x,y,z], angleDeg, pointMm?}, assembly axes, right-hand rule.

angleDeg.description: Degrees, right-hand rule about the axis.

pointMm.description: Move only: a point on the axis, mm (default: the component origin).

absolute.description: Set the placement instead of moving by it.

doc.description: Assembly (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: asm_interference
tools.title: Interference check
tools.description: Interference / collision detection between components (SOLIDWORKS Interference Detection). Returns each interfering pair with its overlap volume mm³ and center; count 0 when clear.

components.description: Only interferences involving this component, or among these (default: all).

doc.description: Assembly (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: asm_replace
tools.title: Replace component
tools.description: Replace a component with another saved part or assembly: this instance, or all instances of its file; mates are re-attached where possible. Verified: the instance(s) now reference the new file. Returns the new names and the mates in error afterwards.

path.description: A saved .sldprt/.sldasm (relative: the output folder), or an open saved document (handle D2 or title).

allInstances.description: Replace every instance of the component's file.

reattachMates.description: Re-attach the mates to the new component.

configuration.description: Configuration of the new file (default: the same name).

doc.description: Assembly (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: asm_pattern
tools.title: Pattern / mirror components
tools.description: Pattern or mirror components as instances of the same files: linear along a direction (optional second one), circular about an axis, or mirror about a plane; oppositeHand:true writes mirrored part files instead (never replacing one). Counts include the seed. Verified: every new instance's placement (the seed moved by i·spacing, turned by k·angle, or reflected; opposite hands vertex by vertex), else rolled back.

spacingMm.description: linear: distance between instances in mm.

direction.description: linear: +x | -x | +y | -y | +z | -z (assembly axes); with directionRef, the sign along it.

directionRef.description: linear: a straight edge, axis, plane or planar face giving the direction, e.g. {component:'rail-1', type:'edge', at:[x,y,z]}.

direction2.description: linear: second direction, an assembly axis such as "+z".

count2.description: linear: instances in direction 2, the seed row included.

spacing2Mm.description: linear: spacing in direction 2 in mm.

axis.description: circular: an axis, a cylindrical face or a circular/straight edge, e.g. {component:'hub-1', at:[x,y,z]} (part mm).

totalAngleDeg.description: circular: with equalSpacing the angle spanned (default 360 = full circle), else the angle between instances.

equalSpacing.description: circular: spread the instances evenly (default true).

plane.description: mirror: the plane, e.g. {name:'right'} or {component:'base-1', name:'front'}.

oppositeHand.description: mirror: make opposite-hand parts (new mirrored part files) instead of instances.

suffix.description: oppositeHand: appended to the seed part's file name (default "_mirror").

folder.description: oppositeHand: folder for the new files (default: the seed parts' folder).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the result even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Assembly (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: asm_bom
tools.title: Bill of materials (data)
tools.description: Bill of materials of the assembly as data, no drawing needed: item, part number (PartNo / Part Number property, else the file name), description, material, quantity, mass, file and configuration; levels top, parts (every part, quantities through subassemblies) or indented. Suppressed, excluded and envelope components are left out (listed). Optional CSV file (Excel). Verified: the quantities add up to the instances; the CSV read back.

path.description: A .csv file to write, e.g. "bom.csv" (relative paths go under Documents\solidworks-mcp).

doc.description: Assembly (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: asm_explode
tools.title: Exploded view
tools.description: Exploded view of the assembly (a new one in the active configuration): steps that move components along assembly axes, applied in order; drawings can show it. Verified: every component moved by the sum of its steps; else the view is deleted. collapse:true shows the assembly collapsed again afterwards.

steps.description: Steps in order, e.g. [{components:['lid-1'], direction:'+y', distanceMm:60}].

components.description: Components moved in this step, e.g. ["bolt-1","washer-1"].

distanceMm.description: How far they move in mm.

collapse.description: Show the assembly collapsed again at the end (the exploded view is kept).

doc.description: Assembly (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: asm_structure
tools.title: Form or dissolve subassembly
tools.description: Restructures an assembly. form: moves top-level components into a new subassembly (virtual, or saved with saveTo). dissolve: moves a subassembly's components up and removes it. Verified: the components are where expected and every part's quantity in the tree is unchanged.

components.description: form: the components, e.g. ['bolt-1','nut-1']; dissolve: the subassembly.

saveTo.description: form: save the new subassembly to this .sldasm.

doc.description: Assembly (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: vba_run
tools.title: Run VBA (last resort)
tools.description: Runs SolidWorks BASIC code (VBA-like) inside SOLIDWORKS — a last resort when no tool fits. Off unless the user set SWMCP_VBA=on. The API inside uses METERS and RADIANS: helpers MM(x) and DEG(a) convert. Predefined: swApp, swDoc (the target document), Echo(text) for output. Declare variables with Dim x As Object/Double/Long/String; don't name anything Log, Imp, Eqv or Mod. Returns the output, errors (trapped or from the error dialog), whether it compiled, and features added.

code.description: Statements to run (the body of a Sub; no Sub/End Sub needed).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path) bound to swDoc; default: the target document.

tools.name: body_move
tools.title: Move/copy bodies
tools.description: Move / copy / rotate bodies (Move/Copy Body): rotate about an axis through a point, then translate; copies>0 keeps the bodies and adds copies, copy k moved k times. Verified: each body and copy is where the motion puts it (vertices, center of mass) and the body count; else rolled back.

copies.description: 0 = move; n = make n copies (the originals stay).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: body_delete
tools.title: Delete/keep bodies
tools.description: Delete bodies, or keep only the listed ones (Delete/Keep Body feature; undo by deleting it). Verified: exactly those bodies are gone, the others unchanged; reports the removed body names.

bodies.description: Bodies to delete (or to keep), e.g. [{id:'B2'}].

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: body_combine
tools.title: Combine bodies
tools.description: Combine solid bodies: add (union), subtract (main minus tools), common (intersection). Verified by the bodies' volumes; else rolled back. subtract is live-verified; add and common are experimental ('method' names the API variant that worked).

main.description: The main body (subtract: the one that is cut).

tools.description: The other bodies, e.g. [{id:'B2'}].

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: body_split
tools.title: Split body
tools.description: Split solid bodies with a plane, planar face or sketch (the pieces stay in the part; experimental). Verified: more bodies whose volumes add up to the original, other bodies unchanged; else rolled back.

tool.description: Trim tool: {name:'right'}, a planar face {at:[x,y,z]} or a sketch {name:'Sketch2'}.

body.description: Only this solid body (default: all the tool crosses).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: surface_extrude
tools.title: Extruded surface
tools.description: Extruded surface from a sketch (open or closed profile; no caps). Verified: a new surface body spanning the depth on the requested side of the sketch plane, solids unchanged; else rolled back.

direction.description: normal (along the sketch normal) | reverse | a model axis like "+y".

bothSides.description: Mid-plane: half the depth on each side.

sketch.description: Sketch name (default: the open sketch, else the last finished one).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: surface_revolve
tools.title: Revolved surface
tools.description: Revolved surface: spins a sketch profile around an axis, by default the sketch's only centerline (experimental). Verified: a new surface body whose faces are all coaxial with the axis; else rolled back.

axis.description: Axis in the sketch plane: a centerline {name:'Line2'}, a reference axis or a straight edge.

sketch.description: Sketch name (default: the open sketch, else the last finished one).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: surface_planar
tools.title: Planar surface
tools.description: Planar surface filling a closed sketch profile, or a closed loop of edges in one plane (experimental). Verified: a new surface body of planar faces in that plane; else rolled back.

edges.description: Boundary edges instead of a sketch, e.g. [{where:{extreme:'+y'},expect:4}].

sketch.description: Sketch name (default: the open sketch, else the last finished one).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: surface_fill
tools.title: Filled surface
tools.description: Filled surface: a patch over a closed loop of edges (a hole in a surface, an open end), optionally merged with the surfaces around it or closed into a solid. Verified: the patch touches every boundary edge, a planar loop's patch has its area, solid:true makes a solid; else rolled back.

continuity.description: contact (default) or tangent to the faces along the edges.

merge.description: Merge the patch with the adjacent surfaces.

solid.description: Form a solid when the surfaces enclose a volume.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: surface_trim
tools.title: Trim, extend or untrim surfaces
tools.description: Surface editing. kind trim: cut surfaces with a tool (plane, sketch or surface) or each other (surfaces), keeping the pieces at keepAt (or removing those at removeAt). extend: grow edges (or faces) by distanceMm, linear or natural. untrim: fill a face's holes (edge holes|outer|all). Verified by the pieces and the area change; else rolled back.

tool.description: trim: the cutting plane, sketch or surface face, e.g. {name:'Right Plane'}.

surfaces.description: trim: surfaces trimming each other (instead of tool).

keepAt.description: trim: points [x,y,z] mm on pieces to keep.

removeAt.description: trim: points on pieces to remove.

edges.description: extend / untrim: edges of the surface.

linear.description: extend: linearly instead of along the surface.

edge.description: untrim a face: holes (default), outer or all.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: surface_offset
tools.title: Offset surface
tools.description: Offset surface: copies faces at a distance along their normals (0 = a copy; experimental). Verified: a new surface body with planar faces at the distance (same area), cylinders at r ± distance; else rolled back.

distanceMm.description: Offset distance in mm (0 or more).

flip.description: Offset against the face normals (into a solid).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: surface_knit
tools.title: Knit surfaces
tools.description: Knit (sew) surface bodies that share edges into one; trySolid closes a watertight set into a solid (experimental). Verified: the inputs merged or a solid with volume formed ('solidFormed').

surfaces.description: Surface bodies: {id:'B3'} (body_list) or {at:[x,y,z]} on one of their faces.

trySolid.description: Try to form a solid from a closed set.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: surface_thicken
tools.title: Thicken surface
tools.description: Thicken a surface body into a solid. Verified: a flat sheet gains exactly area x thickness (both: the total is reported), a curved one about that; else rolled back.

surface.description: The surface body: {id:'B2'} (body_list) or {at:[x,y,z]} on its face.

side.description: one | other | both (sides of the surface).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: face_edit
tools.title: Edit faces directly
tools.description: Direct face editing, no feature history needed (e.g. an imported STEP): delete faces and heal the gap (patch: the neighbours grow over it, removing a hole, fillet or boss), offset faces along their normals, or move them. Verified: the faces are gone from their spot, or lie at the new distance or position (planes, cylinders), the body stays solid; else rolled back.

faces.description: Faces, e.g. [{id:'F3'}] or a hole: [{where:{surface:'cylinder', radiusMm:3}, expect:1}].

heal.description: delete: patch (default) | fill | tangent_fill | none (leaves the body open).

distanceMm.description: offset: mm along each face's outward normal; positive adds material (a hole gets smaller).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: doc_new
tools.title: New document
tools.description: Creates a new part, assembly or drawing (owned by this server) and makes it the target document. Units default to MMGS (mm, g, s) whatever the template says. A drawing starts as A3 landscape, ISO sheet format, first angle, 1:1 (drw_sheet_setup changes it).

units.description: mmgs (default) | cgs | mks | ips | template (keep the template's units).

template.description: Optional template file (.prtdot/.asmdot/.drwdot); default: the user's default template.

name.description: Optional document name (used as the file name when saved).

tools.name: doc_list
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: Lists open documents: handle (D1…), title, path, type, dirty, access (owned = created by this server; adopted = the user allowed edits; foreign = the user's, read-only), active and target flags, units.

tools.name: doc_activate
tools.title: Activate document
tools.description: Makes a document active and the session's target. With allowEdit=true, a user document becomes editable for this server (a backup copy is saved first) — only do this when the user asked you to change that document.

doc.description: Handle (D2), title or path of an open document.

allowEdit.description: Allow this server to modify the user's document (never discard or rename it).

tools.name: doc_save
tools.title: Save document
tools.description: Saves the target document. mode: inPlace (existing file), as (Save As: the document becomes the new file; owned documents only) or copy (writes a copy, the document is unchanged). Relative paths go under Documents\solidworks-mcp. Existing files need overwrite=true (a file this server didn't write is backed up first). Verifies the file was written.

path.description: Target file for as/copy (.sldprt/.sldasm; the extension is added if missing).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: doc_pack
tools.title: Pack and Go
tools.description: Pack and Go: copies a saved part, assembly or drawing with every file it references (and the models' drawings) into one folder, optionally renamed with a prefix or suffix, the copies referencing each other. The open document stays as it is. Verified: every copy written; the copied assemblies and drawings reference the copies only.

folder.description: Target folder (relative paths go under Documents\solidworks-mcp); default <name>_pack.

prefix.description: Put this before every copied file's name.

suffix.description: Put this after every copied file's name.

includeDrawings.description: Also copy the drawings of the models.

flatten.description: All copies in one folder (else the original folder structure).

overwrite.description: Replace files that exist (backed up unless this server wrote them).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: doc_close
tools.title: Close document
tools.description: Closes a document this server owns (or the user allowed). A document with unsaved changes needs save=true or discard=true (discard only for documents this server created). The user's own documents are never closed.

save.description: Save before closing (the document must already have a file).

discard.description: Throw away unsaved changes (owned documents only).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: drw_sheet_setup
tools.title: Drawing sheet setup
tools.description: Sheet size / paper, orientation, scale, projection (first or third angle) and sheet format (title block) of the current sheet, or of 'sheet' (it becomes current); omitted settings stay. Verified by reading the sheet back (a mismatch restores the previous setup).

size.description: a4 | a3 | a2 | a1 | a0 | a | b | c | d | e | user

projection.description: first_angle | third_angle; default with a new format: iso first, ansi third.

format.description: iso | ansi | none | path of a .slddrt sheet format.

sheet.description: The sheet to set up and make current (drw_info lists them); default: the current sheet.

doc.description: Drawing (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: drw_sheet_add
tools.title: Add drawing sheet
tools.description: Adds a sheet to the drawing and makes it current (later views and tables go on it); size, scale, projection and format default to the current sheet's. Verified: the sheet count, the new sheet current, and its setup read back; else removed.

size.description: a4 | a3 | a2 | a1 | a0 | a | b | c | d | e | user

format.description: iso | ansi | none | path of a .slddrt sheet format.

doc.description: Drawing (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: drw_view_add
tools.title: Flat-pattern or auxiliary view
tools.description: Adds a flat-pattern view of a saved sheet-metal part (the blank, with bend lines) or an auxiliary view looking square onto an angled edge of a parent view. Verified: the view's type and model, the auxiliary direction square to the edge, overlaps; else removed.

model.description: flat_pattern: the saved sheet-metal part (path, handle or title).

edge.description: auxiliary: a straight edge of the parent's model to look square at, e.g. {type:'edge', at:[x,y,z]} (model mm).

atMm.description: The view's centre [x,y] sheet mm; default: a free spot (beside the parent for auxiliary).

scale.description: flat_pattern: view scale, e.g. "1:2" (default: the sheet's).

doc.description: Drawing (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: drw_view_edit
tools.title: Break view / broken-out section
tools.description: Edits a view: break (shortens a long part between two break lines, sheet mm) or broken_out (cuts a circular window depthMm into the model to show inside). Verified: break lines and a shorter outline, or one more broken-out section; else undone.

lines.description: break: vertical (lines across a horizontal part, positions on sheet x) | horizontal (positions on sheet y).

fromMm.description: break: first break line, sheet mm.

toMm.description: break: second break line, sheet mm.

style.description: break: zigzag | straight | small_zigzag | curve | jagged

centerMm.description: broken_out: the cut's centre [x,y] sheet mm.

radiusMm.description: broken_out: the cut's radius, sheet mm.

depthMm.description: broken_out: cut depth, model mm from the front.

doc.description: Drawing (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: drw_views_standard
tools.title: Standard drawing views
tools.description: Standard / orthographic views (front, top, right, iso, ...) of a saved part or assembly, laid out for the sheet's projection without overlaps and scaled to fit unless scale is given. Verified per view: model, orientation and scale read back. Returns each view's name, centerMm, boundsMm (outline) and modelBoxMm (the model box on the sheet).

model.description: Saved .sldprt/.sldasm path, or an open saved document (handle or title).

views.description: front | top | right | iso | back | bottom | left; default [front, top, right, iso].

scale.description: View scale, e.g. "1:2"; default: the sheet scale if it fits, else a standard scale that does.

doc.description: Drawing (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: drw_view_projected
tools.title: Projected view
tools.description: Projected view of a parent view on one side of it (the sheet's first/third-angle projection decides what it shows). Verified: a projected view on that side, looking perpendicular to the parent; otherwise removed.

parent.description: Parent view name, e.g. "Drawing View1" (drw_info lists views).

direction.description: left | right | up | down: where the new view goes.

doc.description: Drawing (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: drw_view_section
tools.title: Section view
tools.description: Section view (A-A) along a straight cut line across the parent view, in sheet mm; the line must cross the whole part (see modelBoxMm in drw_info). Verified: a section view looking along the cutting-plane normal, showing the cut extents; otherwise removed.

parent.description: Parent view name, e.g. "Drawing View1" (drw_info lists views).

lineStartMm.description: Cut line start [x,y] sheet mm, outside the part.

lineEndMm.description: Cut line end [x,y] sheet mm, outside the part.

label.description: View label letter; default: the next free one.

atMm.description: Center of the new view [x,y] sheet mm; default: free space beside the parent.

doc.description: Drawing (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: drw_view_detail
tools.title: Detail view
tools.description: Detail view: an enlarged circular region of the parent view (center and radius in sheet mm). Verified: a detail view at the scale, otherwise removed; warns when it shows no edges (detail views looked empty in earlier tests: check a PDF).

parent.description: Parent view name, e.g. "Drawing View1" (drw_info lists views).

centerMm.description: Circle center [x,y] sheet mm, on the part.

scale.description: Detail scale, e.g. "2:1"; default: twice the parent's.

label.description: View label letter; default: the next free one.

atMm.description: Center of the new view [x,y] sheet mm; default: free space beside the parent.

doc.description: Drawing (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: drw_dimensions_auto
tools.title: Insert model dimensions
tools.description: Model items / auto dimensions: inserts the model's sketch and feature dimensions (marked for drawing) into the views. Returns the dimensions added per view, counted before and after; none comes with a hint why.

doc.description: Drawing (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: drw_dimension_add
tools.title: Drawing dimension
tools.description: Dimension edges or vertices of the view's model in a drawing view (a reference dimension): linear, horizontal, vertical, radial, diameter, angular, or a hole callout (Hole Wizard holes: size, depth, thread). References are in model mm, e.g. a:{type:'edge',at:[0,30,20]}. Verified: the value SOLIDWORKS reads equals the geometry, otherwise removed. Tolerances: dimension_tolerance_set with the returned name.

a.description: Edge or vertex of the view's model.

b.description: Second edge or vertex (distance or angle).

kind.description: linear | horizontal | vertical | radial | diameter | angular | hole_callout

textAtMm.description: Dimension text [x,y] sheet mm; default: beside the view.

doc.description: Drawing (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: drw_note_add
tools.title: Drawing note
tools.description: Note / text on the sheet, or in a view (it then moves with the view), at [x,y] sheet mm; \n starts a new line. Verified: text and position read back.

atMm.description: Position [x,y] sheet mm, from the lower-left corner.

view.description: View to attach the note to; default: the sheet.

doc.description: Drawing (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: drw_annotation_add
tools.title: Drawing annotation
tools.description: GD&T and symbols in a view, on an edge of the view's model (model mm): datum feature (label), surface finish (roughness Ra), geometric tolerance frame (characteristic, tolerance, Ø, MMC/LMC, datums), ISO weld symbol (type, size, length, side, all around, field) or a BOM balloon (without 'at': every component). Verified: what it reads back and the attachment; otherwise removed.

at.description: Edge or vertex it points to (model mm), e.g. {type:'edge',at:[0,20,10]}; gtol, balloon: optional.

atMm.description: Symbol position [x,y] sheet mm; default: beside the edge, outside the view.

roughness.description: surface_finish: roughness Ra in µm, e.g. "1.6".

characteristic.description: gtol: flatness, straightness, circularity, cylindricity, line_profile, surface_profile, parallelism, perpendicularity, angularity, position, concentricity, symmetry, circular_runout, total_runout

weld.description: weld: fillet (default) | square | v | bevel | u | j | butt | backing | plug | spot | seam

size.description: weld: text left of the symbol, e.g. "a5" (throat).

length.description: weld: text right of the symbol, e.g. "50" (length).

doc.description: Drawing (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: drw_table_add
tools.title: Hole, revision or cut-list table
tools.description: Hole table for a view of a part (tag, X/Y from a datum origin vertex, size of each hole through a face), a weldment cut-list table for a view of a weldment (members, lengths, quantities), or a revision table with new rows (A, B, …). Verified: every hole's row, one row per cut-list item, or every revision read back; otherwise removed.

view.description: hole, cut_list: the view (drw_info lists views).

origin.description: hole: datum origin vertex (model mm), e.g. {type:'vertex',at:[-50,-30,20]}; default: the face's lowest-left vertex.

face.description: hole: planar face the holes go through; default: the face toward the viewer with the most holes.

revisions.description: revision: one description per new revision, e.g. ["First release"].

atMm.description: Table corner [x,y] sheet mm (hole: top-left, default below the view; revision, cut_list: top-right, default the sheet's).

doc.description: Drawing (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: drw_bom_add
tools.title: Bill of materials
tools.description: BOM / bill of materials table (top level) for the model shown in a view. Returns the rows and columns read back from the table.

atMm.description: Table top-right corner [x,y] sheet mm; default: the sheet's top-right corner.

doc.description: Drawing (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: drw_center_marks
tools.title: Center marks
tools.description: Center marks on the holes seen face-on in drawing views. Returns the center marks added per view, counted before and after; none comes with a hint why.

views.description: View names; default: the views of the current sheet.

doc.description: Drawing (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: drw_info
tools.title: Drawing info
tools.description: Drawing overview: sheets (size, scale, projection, format) and their views (name, type, orientation, scale, centerMm, boundsMm, modelBoxMm, model, configuration, parent) with annotation counts (dimensions, notes, tables, center marks). Positions are sheet mm from the lower-left corner.

doc.description: Drawing (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: model_export
tools.title: Export (STEP, STL, PDF, ...)
tools.description: Export, save as STEP/STL/IGES/Parasolid/3MF/PNG/JPG/eDrawings/PDF, and DWG/DXF from drawings; the file extension picks the format. Relative paths go under Documents\solidworks-mcp; an existing file needs overwrite=true (backed up first unless this server wrote it). The export options are set only for this call and restored. Verified from the file itself: written by this call, not empty, header and details (STEP schema = AP, STL triangle count and size formula, image size). Returns the path actually written (e.g. .STL in capitals).

path.description: Output file, e.g. bracket.step, part.stl, view.png (the extension is added from 'format' when missing).

format.description: step | iges | parasolid | stl | 3mf | png | jpg | eprt | pdf | dwg | dxf; default: from the extension.

stlDeviationMm.description: STL custom: maximum chordal deviation in mm.

stlAngleDeg.description: STL custom: angle tolerance in degrees (0-90).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: model_export_all
tools.title: Release package (batch export)
tools.description: Release package in one call: for a saved part or assembly and every model file in it, a STEP (or IGES / Parasolid / STL / 3MF) each, a PDF of each drawing saved next to its model under the same name, a flat DXF of each sheet-metal part, and the parts-only BOM as CSV, all in one folder. Each file is checked like model_export; what can't be made (no drawing, not saved, not sheet metal) is listed with the reason.

formats.description: step | iges | parasolid | stl | 3mf | pdf | dxf | bom (default step, pdf, dxf, bom).

folder.description: Output folder (relative paths go under Documents\solidworks-mcp); default <name>_release.

overwrite.description: Replace files that exist (backed up unless this server wrote them).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_info
tools.title: Feature details
tools.description: Feature details: type, rebuild error, suppressed/rolled back, parents, children, absorbed sketches, dimensions, and the definition of extrudes (end condition, depth, draft), revolves, fillets (radius, edges), chamfers, shells, Hole Wizard holes (standard, size, diameter, depth) and linear/circular patterns (counts, spacing). mm and degrees.

feature.description: Feature name, e.g. Boss-Extrude1 (feature_list shows them).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_delete
tools.title: Delete features
tools.description: Deletes features by name. By default only the features themselves: absorbed sketches stay, and the call refuses (listing them) when other features depend on them. dryRun lists what would go. Verified: the features are gone; returns everything removed and the volume change.

deleteChildren.description: Also delete the features that depend on them.

dryRun.description: Only report what would be deleted.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_suppress_set
tools.title: Suppress or unsuppress
tools.description: Suppresses or unsuppresses features (dependents follow a suppressed parent). Verified by reading the state back; returns the previous states, the other features that changed with them and the new volume.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_recognize
tools.title: Recognize features (FeatureWorks)
tools.description: Turns an imported body (STEP, IGES, Parasolid from doc_open) into editable features with FeatureWorks: extrudes, revolves, holes, fillets and chamfers, volume features, ribs, sheet metal. Verified: new features, the same volume, no rebuild errors; else undone. Then dimension_set and the feature tools work on them.

kinds.description: Kinds: extrude, revolve, holes, fillets, volume, ribs, sheetmetal (default: the first five).

constrainSketches.description: Fix the new sketches (fully defined) instead of leaving them under defined.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_rename
tools.title: Rename feature
tools.description: Renames a feature (names are unique). Verified by reading the name back; returns the previous name and the renamed dimensions (D1@NewName).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_rollback
tools.title: Move rollback bar
tools.description: Moves the rollback bar after a feature (before it with before=true), or back to the end. Verified with every feature's rolled-back state. Rolled-back features are inactive and new features are inserted at the bar: roll to 'end' when done.

before.description: Put the bar before the feature instead of after it.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: dimension_list
tools.title: List dimensions
tools.description: Dimensions of a feature (with its absorbed sketch), of a sketch, or of the whole model: name for dimension_set (D1@Boss-Extrude1), value in mm, deg or count, and a driven flag for reference dimensions.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: dimension_set
tools.title: Set dimensions
tools.description: Sets dimension values in one batch with one rebuild: mm for lengths, degrees for angles, whole numbers for counts. Refuses driven or equation-driven dimensions and an open sketch. Verified: every value reads back after the rebuild and no feature fails, else all values are restored. Returns previous and new values and the volume change.

name.description: Dimension name from dimension_list, e.g. D1@Boss-Extrude1 or D2@Sketch1.

value.description: New value: mm for lengths, degrees for angles, a whole number for counts.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: dimension_tolerance_set
tools.title: Set dimension tolerances
tools.description: Tolerances and fits on dimensions (part, assembly, or a drawing's own dimensions): bilateral +upper/lower, limit, symmetric ±, basic, min/max, or ISO fits (H7, g6; fit_with_tolerance shows SOLIDWORKS' deviations). Model dimensions carry them into drawings. Verified: type, deviations and fit classes read back, else all restored; returns the limits.

tolerances.description: Tolerances, e.g. [{name:'D1@Sketch1', type:'bilateral', upper:0.1, lower:-0.05}, {name:'D2@Sketch1', type:'fit', hole:'H7'}].

name.description: Dimension name: from dimension_list (part, assembly) or as drw_dimension_add returned it (drawing), e.g. D1@Sketch1.

type.description: none | basic | bilateral | limit | symmetric | min | max | fit | fit_with_tolerance | fit_tolerance_only

upper.description: bilateral, limit: the upper deviation; symmetric: the ± value. In the dimension's unit (mm, deg for angles).

lower.description: bilateral, limit: the lower deviation, usually negative, e.g. -0.05.

hole.description: Fit types: the ISO hole class, e.g. H7.

shaft.description: Fit types: the ISO shaft class, e.g. g6.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: doc_rebuild
tools.title: Rebuild document
tools.description: Rebuilds the document (force=true regenerates every feature) and returns the features with rebuild errors or warnings (What's Wrong), the duration and the model state.

force.description: Rebuild every feature, not only the changed ones.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: doc_undo
tools.title: Undo
tools.description: Undoes the last SOLIDWORKS undo steps (one feature creation is one step), only in documents this server may edit, only while nobody else changed them since the server's last change, and never more steps than the server made. Returns the features removed or restored and the volume change.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: doc_units_set
tools.title: Set document units
tools.description: Sets the unit system of a document this server created. Tool inputs and outputs stay mm and degrees. Refused, and set back, when equations with unitless numbers would change the geometry. Returns the previous units.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_extrude
tools.title: Extrude (boss or cut)
tools.description: Extrudes a closed sketch profile into a boss, or cuts it (cut=true). Uses the open/last sketch unless 'sketch' is given. Verified: the feature exists without errors, the volume grew (boss) or shrank (cut), and the end cap lies at the requested depth; otherwise it is rolled back. Returns the feature, its dimensions (e.g. D1@Boss-Extrude1), the new faces with ids and the model extents.

depthMm.description: Depth in mm (blind; total thickness for mid_plane).

cut.description: Cut material instead of adding it.

direction.description: normal (along the sketch normal) | reverse | auto (cuts: into the material, the default) | a model axis like "+y" | "x,y,z".

sketch.description: Sketch to extrude (default: the open sketch, else the last finished one).

merge.description: Merge the result with existing bodies (boss).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_fillet
tools.title: Fillet
tools.description: Rounds edges (and/or all edges of faces) with a constant radius, e.g. edges:[{where:{curve:'line', parallelTo:'y'}, expect:4}]. Kinds: variable (one edge, radiiMm at its ends, the first at startAt), face (blends faces with faces2), full_round (faces and faces2 are the sides, centerFaces rounded away). Verified: no errors, the volume changed, a round face of the radius (variable: the bigger radius at its end); otherwise rolled back.

radiusMm.description: Fillet radius in mm (not for variable and full_round).

faces.description: Faces whose edges are all rounded; face: the first set; full_round: one side.

faces2.description: face: the second set; full_round: the other side.

centerFaces.description: full_round: the faces between the sides.

radiiMm.description: variable: [radius at one end, at the other] in mm.

startAt.description: variable: a point at the end of the first radius (default: the edge's start).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_thread
tools.title: Modelled thread
tools.description: A modelled (helical) ISO metric thread from a circular edge: a shaft's end gets an external thread (Metric Die), a hole's rim an internal one (Metric Tap; drill it at the tap size). For 3D printing, renders and fit checks; drawings and BOMs only need feature_thread_cosmetic. Verified: the volume moved lies within the thread's annulus.

edge.description: Circular edge where the thread starts.

method.description: cut (the groove is cut) | extrude (the thread is added).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_split_line
tools.title: Split line
tools.description: Splits faces by projecting a sketch onto them (a load or fixture region, a partial face to paint or draft). Uses the open/last sketch unless 'sketch' is given. Verified: more faces, the same volume and area; otherwise rolled back.

sketch.description: Sketch name (default: the open or last sketch).

direction.description: both (default) | normal | reverse: project both ways, or one way along/against the sketch normal.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: hardware_part
tools.title: Standard part
tools.description: Makes (or reuses) a standard part file from the standard's table, without Toolbox: ISO 4762 socket head and ISO 4017 hex head screws, ISO 4032 nuts, ISO 7089 washers, ISO 8734 dowel pins, ISO 15 ball bearings (simplified envelope). Cosmetic thread, Alloy Steel, PartNo and Description for BOMs. Verified: the volume is the table's geometry.

standard.description: ISO 4762 | ISO 4017 | ISO 4032 | ISO 7089 | ISO 8734 | ISO 15

lengthMm.description: Screws and pins: a preferred length (the error lists them).

folder.description: Library folder for the parts (default: 'hardware' in the output folder).

tools.name: asm_fastener
tools.title: Fasten screws
tools.description: Screws into holes: per hole (its centre on the face the head sits on) inserts an ISO screw, washers and a nut on the far side if asked, each mated concentric with the hole and seated. Without lengthMm a nut gets the shortest screw standing two threads past it. Verified: each part on the hole's axis at its seat; reports grip and protrusion.

holes.description: Hole centres on the head's face, assembly mm, e.g. [[20,10,15],[-20,10,15]].

lengthMm.description: Screw length, mm (optional with a nut).

washer.description: ISO 7089 washers under the head and the nut.

nut.description: An ISO 4032 nut on the far side (through holes).

folder.description: Library folder for the parts (default: 'hardware' in the output folder).

doc.description: Assembly (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sw_help
tools.title: Help and guides
tools.description: Help, guides and recipes for this server: conventions (units, axes, points, documents), entityref (referencing faces, edges and planes), workflow_plate, workflow_enclosure, editing (existing parts, STEP files), recovery (every error code and what to do), tools (all tools with their parameters). Without a topic: the index. Makes no SOLIDWORKS call.

topic.description: conventions | entityref | workflow_plate | workflow_enclosure | editing | recovery | tools; default: the index.

tools.name: model_info
tools.title: Model summary
tools.description: Summary of the target document: type, units, configurations, material, bodies (id, volume), total volume, area, mass, center of mass, bounding box (mm), feature count and open sketch.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_list
tools.title: Feature tree
tools.description: The feature tree (FeatureManager) in order: name, type, rebuild error/warning, suppressed, rolled back, children (absorbed sketches) and parents.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: face_list
tools.title: List faces
tools.description: Faces matching a filter, each with an id (usable as {id}), surface type, area, a pick point inside the face, the normal (planar) or axis and radius (cylinder/cone), and the feature that made it. Filter examples: {surface:'plane', normal:'+y'} (top faces), {surface:'cylinder', radiusMm:3}, {feature:'Cut-Extrude1'}, {extreme:'+y'}.

where.description: Filter: surface, normal, parallelTo, radiusMm, near+withinMm, extreme, feature, body, component.

parallelTo.description: Line direction or axis parallel to: x, y, z or 'x,y,z'.

radiusMm.description: Radius in mm (faces and circular edges).

extreme.description: Only the extreme ones along an axis: +y = highest, -x = lowest.

feature.description: Made by this feature, e.g. Boss-Extrude1.

ofFace.description: Edges/vertices of this face id, e.g. F2.

angleTolDeg.description: Angle tolerance in degrees for normal/parallelTo (default 1).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: edge_list
tools.title: List edges
tools.description: Edges matching a filter, each with an id, curve type, length, start/end/mid points (mid resolves back to the edge), and radius/center/axis for circles. Filter examples: {curve:'line', parallelTo:'y'} (vertical edges), {ofFace:{id:'F2'}, loop:'outer'}, {curve:'circle', radiusMm:5}, {feature:'Boss-Extrude1'}.

where.description: Filter: curve, parallelTo, radiusMm, lengthMm, ofFace (+loop), near+withinMm, extreme, feature, body, component.

parallelTo.description: Line direction or axis parallel to: x, y, z or 'x,y,z'.

radiusMm.description: Radius in mm (faces and circular edges).

extreme.description: Only the extreme ones along an axis: +y = highest, -x = lowest.

feature.description: Made by this feature, e.g. Boss-Extrude1.

ofFace.description: Edges/vertices of this face id, e.g. F2.

angleTolDeg.description: Angle tolerance in degrees for normal/parallelTo (default 1).

withFaces.description: Also report the ids of the two faces each edge joins.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: vertex_list
tools.title: List vertices
tools.description: Vertices matching a filter (near, extreme, ofFace, body, component), each with an id and point (mm).

where.description: Filter: near+withinMm, extreme, ofFace, body, component.

parallelTo.description: Line direction or axis parallel to: x, y, z or 'x,y,z'.

radiusMm.description: Radius in mm (faces and circular edges).

extreme.description: Only the extreme ones along an axis: +y = highest, -x = lowest.

feature.description: Made by this feature, e.g. Boss-Extrude1.

ofFace.description: Edges/vertices of this face id, e.g. F2.

angleTolDeg.description: Angle tolerance in degrees for normal/parallelTo (default 1).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: body_list
tools.title: List bodies
tools.description: Bodies of the part: id (B…, usable as {id}), name, solid or surface, volume, area, bounding box (mm), face and edge counts, hidden. Works while a sketch is open.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: model_measure
tools.title: Measure
tools.description: Measure one entity or between two (SOLIDWORKS Measure): distance, normal and center distance, angle, dx/dy/dz, length, area, perimeter, radius, diameter, point coordinates; only the values that apply (mm, mm², deg). Faces, edges, vertices, planes, axes, points, sketch entities, e.g. a:{type:'face', at:[0,20,0]}, b:{name:'top'} ('at' needs a type here).

a.description: The entity to measure, or the first of two.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: model_mass
tools.title: Mass properties
tools.description: Mass properties of the part or assembly, or of one body: mass (kg), volume (mm³), area (mm²), density (kg/m³), center of mass (mm), principal moments (kg·mm²) and axes, inertia tensor at the center of mass. Cross-checked against the bodies' own volumes. SKETCH_STATE while a sketch is open (SOLIDWORKS reads zero then).

body.description: One solid body: {id:'B1'} (body_list), {name:'Boss-Extrude1'} or {at:[x,y,z]} on one of its faces.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: model_check
tools.title: Check geometry
tools.description: Checks. geometry (default): IBody2.Check3 faults of every body, or one. Moldability of the solid: draft (each face's draft range against pull: positive, negative, needs_draft, straddle), undercut (faces that can't release along pull, by ray casts), thickness (wall behind each face by ray casts; thin under limitMm).

minDeg.description: draft / undercut: the least draft that counts, degrees.

limitMm.description: thickness: walls thinner than this are listed as thin, mm.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: model_review
tools.title: Design review
tools.description: Health report of a part or assembly in one call, errors first: features with rebuild errors or warnings, over- and under-defined sketches, suppressed features, a pending rebuild; parts: no material, faulty geometry, several bodies; assemblies: missing, unloaded or suppressed components, floating ones and mate errors. Read-only.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: model_compare
tools.title: Compare revisions
tools.description: Compares two revisions of a part or assembly: volume, area, mass and size (this − other), the features only one of them has (name and type) and every dimension whose value differs. 'other' is an open document (handle, title, path) or a file, which is opened read-only and closed again. same=true when nothing differs.

other.description: The document to compare with: handle, title or path of an open one, or a file path.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: model_section
tools.title: Section properties
tools.description: Section properties of flat faces in one plane (a member's end face is its cross-section): area, centroid, the principal second moments of area with their axes, section moduli (I / farthest fibre), radii of gyration and the polar moment, all about the centroid. Verified: the area is the faces' own, the polar moment the sum of the principal ones.

faces.description: Flat faces in one plane, e.g. [{at:[x,y,z]}] on a member's end.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: model_cost
tools.title: Cost estimate
tools.description: SOLIDWORKS Costing estimate of a single-body part (machined, sheet metal or structural, by how Costing sees the body, with its first template): material, manufacturing and setup cost, the totals to manufacture and to charge, lot size, quantity and the cost items. Needs a material. Verified: the costs are positive and add up.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: model_cut_list
tools.title: Cut list
tools.description: Cut list of a weldment or sheet-metal part, for fabrication: each item (identical bodies) with its quantity, type and properties as SOLIDWORKS resolves them (LENGTH, ANGLE1/2 of members; bounding box, thickness and bends of blanks; description, material). update:true refreshes the cut list first. Verified: the items hold every solid body once.

update.description: Refresh the cut list first (changes the part).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: doc_open
tools.title: Open or import a file
tools.description: Open a file: .sldprt/.sldasm/.slddrw opens silently without a rebuild prompt; STEP/IGES/Parasolid/SAT/STL is imported as a new part (or assembly) with MMGS units and its bodies verified. The document becomes the target and this server may edit it. A file that is already open is not reopened: it becomes the target with alreadyOpen=true and keeps its access (the user's documents stay read-only). Reports load warnings (missing references, read-only, newer version) and, for imports, bodies and volume.

path.description: File to open or import; relative paths are under Documents\solidworks-mcp.

readOnly.description: Open a SOLIDWORKS file read-only (changes need doc_save mode copy/as).

configuration.description: Part/assembly configuration to open; default: the one last saved.

tools.name: feature_revolve
tools.title: Revolve (boss or cut)
tools.description: Revolve / revolved boss / revolved cut (cut=true): spins a closed sketch profile around an axis, by default the sketch's only centerline. Uses the open/last sketch unless 'sketch' is given. Verified: the feature exists without errors, the volume grew (boss) or shrank (cut), and every new face is coaxial with the axis (a partial revolve's end caps at the angle); otherwise it is rolled back.

sketch.description: Sketch to revolve (default: the open sketch, else the last finished one).

axis.description: Axis (default: the sketch's only centerline): a centerline by name {name:'Line5'}, a reference axis {name:'Axis1'} or a straight edge {type:'edge',at:[x,y,z]}; it must lie in the sketch plane.

angle2Deg.description: Angle in the opposite direction in degrees (two-direction revolve; the sum at most 360).

cut.description: Cut material instead of adding it.

merge.description: Merge the result with existing bodies (boss).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_chamfer
tools.title: Chamfer
tools.description: Chamfer / bevel edges: equal distance, two distances or distance + angle. Edges by id, point or query, e.g. edges:[{at:[0,20,30]}]. Verified: a Chamfer feature with faces (an empty chamfer is rejected), the volume or face count changed, and on straight edges the chamfer face's two legs measured; otherwise rolled back.

distanceMm.description: Chamfer distance in mm (the first leg).

distance2Mm.description: distance_distance: the second leg in mm.

angleDeg.description: angle_distance: the angle in degrees (between 0 and 90).

flip.description: Swap which face the first distance (or the angle) applies to.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_shell
tools.title: Shell
tools.description: Shell / hollow out a solid: removes the given faces (open sides) and leaves walls of constant thickness, inward or outward. Verified: a Shell feature without errors, the volume changed, and walls found at the thickness behind (or in front of) the original planar faces; otherwise rolled back.

removeFaces.description: Faces to remove (the open sides), e.g. [{at:[0,20,0]}]; [] makes a closed hollow body.

outward.description: Grow the walls outward instead of inward.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_hole
tools.title: Hole Wizard holes
tools.description: Hole Wizard holes at points on planar faces, drilled against the face normal: drill, clearance (fit), counterbore, countersink, tapped. One HoleWzd feature per point. Verified per hole: a coaxial cylinder of the planned diameter (blind: the requested depth, without the drill tip) and volume removed; on any failure all holes are rolled back. Drill, clearance, counterbore, countersink and through_all are live-verified; tapped is made as its tap-drill hole (no thread geometry) unless SWMCP_EXPERIMENTAL=1.

points.description: Hole centers in model mm, on a planar face: [[x,y,z], ...].

diameterMm.description: Drill: diameter in mm. Others: overrides the table diameter of the through hole.

size.description: Screw size "M5" (tapped also "M6x0.75"), or a drill size "Ø6".

depthMm.description: Blind depth in mm (full diameter, without the drill tip).

face.description: The planar face for all holes (default: the face under each point).

name.description: Rename the new feature (several holes: name1, name2, ...).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_pattern_linear
tools.title: Linear pattern
tools.description: Linear pattern / array of features along a model axis ("+x") or a straight edge, axis or planar face, optionally in a second direction; counts include the seed. Verified: an LPattern feature without errors, the volume or faces changed, and the instance faces at the requested offsets (a pattern SOLIDWORKS ran backwards is redone flipped); otherwise rolled back.

features.description: Features to copy, by name (feature_list), e.g. ["Cut-Extrude1"].

count.description: Instances in direction 1, the seed included.

direction.description: +x | -x | +y | -y | +z | -z; with directionRef, the sign along it.

directionRef.description: Straight edge, axis or planar face (its normal) giving direction 1, instead of a model axis.

direction2.description: Second direction, a model axis such as "+z".

count2.description: Instances in direction 2, the seed row included.

spacing2Mm.description: Distance between instances in direction 2 in mm.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_pattern_circular
tools.title: Circular pattern
tools.description: Circular / polar pattern of features around an axis: a reference axis, a cylindrical face or a circular or straight edge; count includes the seed. Verified: a CirPattern feature without errors, the volume or faces changed, and the instance faces at the expected rotations; otherwise rolled back.

features.description: Features to copy, by name (feature_list), e.g. ["Cut-Extrude1"].

axis.description: Rotation axis, e.g. {name:'Axis1'} or a cylindrical face {type:'face',at:[x,y,z]}.

totalAngleDeg.description: equalSpacing: the angle the instances span (360 = full circle); otherwise the angle between instances.

equalSpacing.description: Spread the instances evenly over totalAngleDeg.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_pattern_curve
tools.title: Curve-driven pattern
tools.description: Patterns features along a curve: an edge or a sketch segment, e.g. {type:'sketch_segment', name:'Arc1', sketch:'Sketch3'}. count includes the seed; spacingMm apart along the curve, or spread equally over it. Verified: no errors, the volume changed and (round seeds) count − 1 new instances; the curve's other sense is tried if the asked one misses the body.

curve.description: The curve: an edge or a sketch segment.

spacingMm.description: Spacing along the curve, mm (default: equal over the whole curve).

reverse.description: Run the other way along the curve.

align.description: tangent (turn with the curve) | seed (keep the seed's orientation).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_pattern_fill
tools.title: Fill pattern
tools.description: Fills a flat face with round holes (holeDiameterMm, cut through) or copies of seed features: perforation (staggered rows), square, circular or polygon layout, spacingMm apart, marginMm from the boundary. Vents, perforated panels. Verified: no errors, the volume changed; round holes are counted.

face.description: The flat face to fill, e.g. {at:[0,2,0]}.

holeDiameterMm.description: Round holes of this diameter, mm: a seed hole is cut through at the face's interior point (or features).

features.description: Seed features to copy instead of holes.

marginMm.description: Distance kept from the boundary, mm.

directionRef.description: perforation/square: a straight edge for the rows (default: the face's longest).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_mirror
tools.title: Mirror features
tools.description: Mirror features about a plane or a planar face. Verified: a MirrorPattern feature without errors, the volume or faces changed, and the new faces are the reflections of the seed's faces; otherwise rolled back.

features.description: Features to copy, by name (feature_list), e.g. ["Cut-Extrude1"].

plane.description: Mirror plane: {name:'right'}, a plane's name, or a planar face {at:[x,y,z]}.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: feature_deform
tools.title: Wrap, dome, indent
tools.description: Shape features. wrap {sketch, faces, type emboss|deboss|scribe, depthMm}: a closed sketch onto planar or curved faces. dome {faces:[one planar face], depthMm, elliptical, reverse}. indent {body, tool: a point on the other body, cut, depthMm, clearanceMm}. Verified by the volume change (a circular face's dome = the spherical cap; an indent cut = the overlap); else rolled back.

faces.description: wrap: target faces; dome: the face.

depthMm.description: wrap height/depth, dome height, indent wall, mm.

tool.description: indent: a point on the tool body, e.g. {at:[x,y,z]}.

cut.description: indent: cut the tool's shape out.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: mold_split
tools.title: Mold core and cavity
tools.description: Splits a molded part's tool into cavity and core: optional shrinkage scale, parting line at the edges between faces drafted towards and against pull (flat parting lines), shut-off surfaces, parting surface, a block marginMm around the part, tooling split. Verified: cavity + core = block − part, no overlaps, cavity on the pull side; else rolled back.

minDraftDeg.description: Least draft for a face to count as drafted, degrees.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep the feature even if verification fails (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: material_list
tools.title: List materials
tools.description: Installed materials from the SOLIDWORKS material databases: name, classification, database and density (kg/m³). Use the exact name with material_set.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring of the name, classification or database, e.g. "steel" or "6061".

tools.name: material_set
tools.title: Set material
tools.description: Assigns a material to the part, e.g. "AISI 1020", "6061 Alloy", "ABS". The name is checked against the installed databases first (SOLIDWORKS silently ignores unknown names; a miss lists the closest ones). Verified: the material reads back and the mass properties show its density. Returns the previous material and the new mass.

name.description: Material name as material_list shows it.

database.description: Database from material_list (default: the one that has the name).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: material_add
tools.title: Add a custom material
tools.description: Adds a custom material (density, E, ν; optionally G, yield and tensile strength, thermal properties) to this server's material library in SOLIDWORKS' custom material folder, so material_set {name, database} and the simulations can use it. Verified: the library reads back with every value and material_list lists it. Only libraries this server wrote are changed.

classification.description: Category shown in the material tree (default solidworks-mcp).

overwrite.description: Replace a material of that name in the library.

tools.name: prop_list
tools.title: List custom properties
tools.description: Custom properties (File > Properties): name, raw value, resolved value (when different, e.g. a linked dimension; numbers in the Windows locale) and type. File level by default, or one configuration's.

configuration.description: Configuration for configuration-specific properties (default: file level).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: prop_set
tools.title: Set custom property
tools.description: Adds or replaces a custom property. Text values may link to a dimension, e.g. "\"D1@Boss-Extrude1\"". Verified by reading the value and type back (on a mismatch the previous state is restored). Returns the previous value.

configuration.description: Configuration for a configuration-specific property (default: file level).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: prop_delete
tools.title: Delete custom property
tools.description: Deletes a custom property and verifies it is gone. Returns what was deleted.

configuration.description: Configuration for a configuration-specific property (default: file level).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: equation_list
tools.title: List equations
tools.description: Equations and global variables: index, text, left-hand side, value (as SOLIDWORKS evaluates it, document units) and whether it is a global variable.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: equation_set
tools.title: Set equation
tools.description: Creates or updates the equation of a global variable (lhs W) or a dimension (lhs D1@Boss-Extrude1), e.g. W = 60mm, D1@Boss-Extrude1 = "W" / 2. Write units on numbers: bare numbers are document units (a warning says so). Unknown names and circular references are refused. Rebuilds, then verifies the value and the driven dimension; rolled back on failure. Returns the previous equation.

lhs.description: Left-hand side without quotes: a global variable (W) or a dimension (D1@Sketch1).

expression.description: Right-hand side, e.g. 60mm or "W" / 2 + 5mm; names in double quotes.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: equation_delete
tools.title: Delete equation
tools.description: Deletes the equation of a left-hand side (a global variable, or a dimension's driving equation; the dimension stays). Refuses a global variable other equations use. Rebuilds and verifies it is gone.

lhs.description: Left-hand side without quotes: W or D1@Sketch1.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: config_list
tools.title: List configurations
tools.description: Configurations of the part or assembly, the active one, and the active configuration's display states (active first).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: config_add
tools.title: Add configuration
tools.description: Adds a configuration and activates it (activate=false keeps the current one active); kind display_state: a display state of the active configuration; kind speedpak: a SpeedPak of the active assembly configuration (name not used). Verified by listing and by the active one; returns the previously active one.

kind.description: "configuration" (default) or "display_state" (of the active configuration). Also speedpak.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: config_activate
tools.title: Activate configuration
tools.description: Makes a configuration active (the model rebuilds in it), or with kind display_state a display state of the active configuration. Verified; returns the previously active one.

name.description: Configuration (or display state) name; config_list shows them.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: config_delete
tools.title: Delete configuration
tools.description: Deletes a configuration (or with kind display_state a display state) that is not active (activate another first). Verified by listing.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: config_table
tools.title: Configuration table
tools.description: Design table without Excel: each row names a configuration (created from the active one when missing) and its values. Columns: a dimension 'D1@Boss-Extrude1' (mm or deg), '$STATE@Fillet1' or a component ('suppressed'/'unsuppressed'), '$PRP@PartNo' (text), '$MATERIAL' (parts), '$CONFIGURATION@bolt-1' (assemblies). Each configuration is activated, rebuilt and read back with its volume and mass; a failure undoes the call. Without rows it reads the table: the given columns, or those that differ between configurations.

values.description: Column → value: a number for dimensions (mm or deg), text for the $ columns.

columns.description: Columns to read when rows are omitted.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: appearance_set
tools.title: Set color
