tools.description: Colors the whole part, one body or one face (color and optional transparency). Verified by reading the appearance back; returns the previous color.

transparency.description: 0 (opaque) to 1 (clear); default: keep the current one.

target.description: A body ({id:'B1'} or {name:'Boss-Extrude1'}) or a face ({id:'F3'} or {at:[x,y,z]}); default: the whole part.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: ref_plane
tools.title: Reference plane
tools.description: Reference (datum) plane. kind: offset {base, offsetMm}, angle {base, axis, angleDeg}, three_points {points}, parallel_point {base, point}, mid_plane {base, second}, normal_to_curve {base: curve, point}. Points (model mm) go into a 3D sketch. Verified against the plane SOLIDWORKS reports, else rolled back; returns its name and frame.

kind.description: offset | angle | three_points | parallel_point | mid_plane | normal_to_curve

base.description: Plane or planar face, e.g. {name:'top'}, {id:'F3'}; normal_to_curve: the edge.

offsetMm.description: offset: along the base normal (faces: outward); negative = other side.

axis.description: angle: straight edge or axis in the base to turn about.

point.description: [x,y,z] mm the plane passes through (normal_to_curve: on the curve; default its start).

second.description: mid_plane: the other plane or planar face.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: ref_axis
tools.title: Reference axis
tools.description: Reference axis. kind: two_planes {entities: 2 crossing planes/planar faces}; two_points {points, or entities: 2 vertices/points}; cylinder {entities: 1 cylindrical/conical face}; edge {entities: 1 straight edge}. Verified: its direction and position match the references, else rolled back. Returns its name and frame (origin, direction).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: ref_point
tools.title: Reference point
tools.description: Reference point. kind: xyz {at}; arc_center {entities: 1 circular edge}; face_center {entities: 1 face}; intersection {entities: 2 crossing edges/axes}. Verified: the point SOLIDWORKS reports is where requested, else rolled back. Returns its name and position (frame.originMm).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: ref_curve
tools.title: Reference curve
tools.description: 3D curve (sweep paths, wires). kind: projected {sketch, faces} (onto faces along the sketch normal) or {sketch, ontoSketch} (where two sketches' extrusions meet); composite {entities: connected edges or sketch segments}; xyz {points}. Verified: on the faces, the joined length, or through every point; else rolled back. Returns length and ends.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: ref_coordsys
tools.title: Coordinate system
tools.description: Coordinate system at an origin ([x,y,z] mm, or a vertex/point), with optional x/y directions from straight edges or axes (default: the model axes). Verified: origin and axes as SOLIDWORKS reports them, else rolled back. Returns its name and frame (origin, x, y and z axes).

origin.description: [x,y,z] model mm, or a vertex/point reference such as {id:'V3'} or {name:'Point1'}.

xAxis.description: Straight edge or axis giving the x direction.

yAxis.description: Straight edge or axis giving the y direction.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sw_status
tools.title: SOLIDWORKS status
tools.description: Status of the SOLIDWORKS connection: version, open documents (handle, owned/adopted/foreign, dirty), the target document, open sketch, visible dialogs, whether a modal dialog blocks SOLIDWORKS, the running operation and recentOps (what happened to calls that timed out). Never hangs: works even while SOLIDWORKS is busy. Call it first, and after any TIMEOUT.

tools.name: sw_connect
tools.title: Connect to SOLIDWORKS
tools.description: Attach to the running SOLIDWORKS (normally automatic), or start it with launch=true (takes a license seat and up to 3 minutes). Never starts a second instance. Reports the revision and any preferences recovered from a crashed session.

launch.description: Start SOLIDWORKS if it is not running. Only when the user asked for it.

tools.name: dialog_list
tools.title: List SOLIDWORKS dialogs
tools.description: Lists visible SOLIDWORKS dialogs (handle, title, text, buttons) and whether one blocks SOLIDWORKS. Works while SOLIDWORKS is blocked. Use it after DIALOG_BLOCKING or TIMEOUT, and tell the user what the dialog says.

tools.name: dialog_respond
tools.title: Answer a SOLIDWORKS dialog
tools.description: Presses a button on a SOLIDWORKS dialog by its handle (from dialog_list). Use it only for dialogs your own call caused, or when the user told you how to answer. Answers that can discard work (Don't Save, Discard, Delete, Replace, No on a save prompt) need confirm=true, which requires the user's approval. Works while SOLIDWORKS is blocked.

button.description: Button caption as shown (e.g. "OK", "Cancel", "End", "Yes"); "ok"/"cancel" also work on dialogs without that caption.

confirm.description: Required for answers that can discard work; only with the user's approval.

tools.name: sheetmetal_base_flange
tools.title: Sheet-metal base flange
tools.description: Sheet-metal base flange / tab: a flat plate from a closed sketch; makes the part sheet metal (Sheet-Metal, Base-Flange, Flat-Pattern). Thickened against the sketch normal (reverse: along it). Verified: the three features, volume = area x thickness, the plate's side, and thickness, bend radius and K-factor read back; else rolled back.

bendRadiusMm.description: Default bend radius in mm (inside radius of later bends).

kFactor.description: K-factor of the bend allowance (0 to 1).

sketch.description: Closed profile sketch (default: the open sketch, else the last finished one).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sheetmetal_edge_flange
tools.title: Sheet-metal edge flange
tools.description: Sheet-metal edge flange: bends a wall up from straight edges of the sheet's face (experimental: several API variants, 'method' names the one that worked). Verified: volume about length x edge x thickness and the part grew toward the flange; else rolled back.

edges.description: Straight edges of the sheet's top/bottom face, e.g. [{type:'edge',at:[25,0,0]}].

bendRadiusMm.description: Bend radius in mm (default: the sheet's).

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sheetmetal_miter_flange
tools.title: Sheet-metal miter flange
tools.description: Sheet-metal miter flange: one flange along a chain of straight edges of the sheet's face (top or bottom), mitered where they meet; the tool sketches its profile (a line lengthMm long at angleDeg) at the chain's free end. Verified: position and gap read back, volume about length x edges x thickness, the part grown toward the flange; else rolled back.

edges.description: Straight edges of one face of the sheet that meet end to end (any order), e.g. [{type:'edge',at:[0,0,15]},{type:'edge',at:[25,0,0]}].

lengthMm.description: Flange length in mm (at 90°: its height above that face).

angleDeg.description: Wall angle from the sheet in degrees (0 to 180; 90 = square, less leans outward).

bendRadiusMm.description: Bend radius in mm (default: the sheet's).

gapMm.description: Rip gap at the mitered corners in mm.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sheetmetal_hem
tools.title: Sheet-metal hem
tools.description: Sheet-metal hem: folds the sheet back on itself along straight edges of its face, closed (flat on the sheet), open (with a gap), teardrop or rolled. Verified: the hem type read back and the added volume about edge x thickness x (length + bend); else rolled back.

edges.description: Straight edges of the sheet's face, e.g. [{type:'edge',at:[25,0,0]}].

gapMm.description: open: gap to the sheet in mm.

position.description: inside (default) | outside: the hem's material inside or outside the sheet's edge.

reverse.description: Fold to the other side of the sheet.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sheetmetal_bend
tools.title: Sheet-metal sketched bend
tools.description: Sketched bend: bends the sheet along a line across its face (model mm; the tool sketches it), the fixedAt side staying put (default: the larger side). Verified: the volume kept and the bent side reaching about length x sin(angle) off the face; else rolled back.

fromMm.description: Bend line start on the sheet's face, [x,y,z] mm.

fixedAtMm.description: A point on the face on the side that stays put; default: the larger side.

radiusMm.description: Bend radius in mm (default: the sheet's).

flip.description: Bend to the other side of the sheet.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sheetmetal_flatten
tools.title: Flatten / fold sheet metal
tools.description: Flatten (flat:true) or fold back (flat:false) a sheet-metal part through its Flat-Pattern feature. Verified: the state read back; when flat, reports the blank's size (two largest box extents, mm) and thickness.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sheetmetal_export_flat
tools.title: Export flat pattern
tools.description: Export the sheet-metal flat pattern to DXF/DWG (optional bend lines); save the part first (doc_save). Relative paths go under Documents\solidworks-mcp. Verified from the file: written by this call, header, and the DXF extents against the flat blank.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sim_static
tools.title: Static stress analysis (FEA)
tools.description: FEA static stress analysis of a part or assembly (SOLIDWORKS Simulation): fixtures, pressure, force and gravity loads, mesh, solve. Returns max von Mises stress (MPa) and where, max displacement (mm) and where, per-axis ranges, factor of safety, fixture reactions against the loads, mesh and timings. Verified: fixtures and loads read back, solver status 0. The study is deleted unless keepStudy. Needs a material (the part's, or 'material'). Blocks SOLIDWORKS while solving.

kind.description: pressure | force | gravity (default: from valueMpa / valueN / valueG).

faces.description: Faces the load acts on (not for gravity: it acts on the whole part).

valueN.description: force: N, > 0, the total over its faces.

direction.description: "normal" (default: pushes into each face) or, for a force or gravity, a model direction [x,y,z] or "-y".

fixedFaces.description: Faces held fixed (all degrees of freedom), e.g. [{at:[0,5,5]}].

kind.description: fixed | roller (no motion normal to flat faces) | symmetry (a flat symmetry plane) | hinge (cylindrical faces turn about their axis).

material.description: Material to assign first, as material_list names it (e.g. "AISI 1020"); default: the part's own.

meshSizeMm.description: Global element size in mm (default: SOLIDWORKS' default for the part).

keepStudy.description: Keep the study and its results in the document (sim_delete removes it later).

convergence.description: Solve on 3 meshes, each element 1/1.5 the size, and report how max displacement and stress change.

nonlinear.description: Use the nonlinear static solver (large displacements; slower).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sim_run
tools.title: Frequency, buckling or thermal analysis (FEA)
tools.description: FEA beyond static stress (sim_static). frequency: natural frequencies (Hz), lowest first (no fixtures: six rigid-body modes at 0 Hz). buckling: load factors (the loads times the first one buckle the part). thermal: steady-state temperatures (°C) and heat flux. Verified: inputs read back, mesh current, solver status 0, results consistent.

kind.description: fixed | roller (no motion normal to flat faces) | symmetry (a flat symmetry plane) | hinge (cylindrical faces turn about their axis).

loads.description: buckling: the loads, as for sim_static.

kind.description: pressure | force | gravity (default: from valueMpa / valueN / valueG).

faces.description: Faces the load acts on (not for gravity: it acts on the whole part).

valueN.description: force: N, > 0, the total over its faces.

direction.description: "normal" (default: pushes into each face) or, for a force or gravity, a model direction [x,y,z] or "-y".

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sim_plot
tools.title: Simulation result plot (image)
tools.description: Image of a result plot of a study kept with keepStudy (sim_static / sim_run): von_mises or displacement (static), mode (frequency, buckling: pass mode), temperature or heat_flux (thermal); deformed shape by default. Verified: the range the plot shows equals the study's results. Returns the plot's range and the PNG.

study.description: Study name (default: the one this server kept).

result.description: von_mises | displacement | mode | temperature | heat_flux (default by the study's type).

file.description: Also save the PNG here (relative paths go under Documents\solidworks-mcp).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sim_list
tools.title: List simulation studies
tools.description: Simulation studies of a part or assembly: name, type, configuration, mesh state and counts, whether results exist (static: max displacement), active, and whether this server created it. Doesn't load the Simulation add-in: when it isn't loaded, says so.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sim_delete
tools.title: Delete simulation studies
tools.description: Deletes Simulation studies: by default the ones this server created in the document (sim_static keepStudy); other studies only by name, and only in documents this server owns. Verified: gone from the study list. Unloads the add-in again if this server loaded it and no study is left.

studies.description: Study names (default: the studies this server created in the document).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_edit
tools.title: Edit sketch
tools.description: Re-opens an existing sketch by name for editing (then sketch_add, sketch_dimension_add, ..., sketch_finish). Returns its frame in model space (origin, x/y axes, normal), segment and relation counts and constrained status. SKETCH_STATE if another sketch is open.

sketch.description: Sketch name, e.g. Sketch1 (feature_list shows them).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_info
tools.title: Sketch info
tools.description: Reads a sketch: segments (name, kind line/arc/circle/ellipse/spline/text, construction, geometry in sketch mm: line start/end, arc center/radius/start/end, length), point and relation counts, constrained status (under/fully/over), contour status (closed/open loops, regions), frame and dimensions (D1@Sketch1 with values).

sketch.description: Sketch name, e.g. Sketch1; default: the open sketch.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_dimension_add
tools.title: Add sketch dimension
tools.description: Adds a driving dimension in the open sketch and sets its value (no Modify dialog). kind: linear (a line's length, or the distance between two entities), horizontal, vertical, radial or diameter (arc/circle), angular (two lines). Verified: the value reads back and the geometry measures it; an over-defining or driven result is removed and refused. Returns the name (D1@Sketch1).

kind.description: linear | horizontal | vertical | radial | diameter | angular

valueMm.description: Value in mm (all kinds but angular); omit to keep the current size.

textAt.description: Text position [x,y] sketch mm; for angular it picks the angle (put it inside the one you mean).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_relation_add
tools.title: Add sketch relation
tools.description: Adds a geometric relation in the open sketch. Takes: horizontal/vertical (lines, or points), coincident (point + point/line/arc; two segment end points merge), collinear/parallel (lines), perpendicular (2 lines), tangent, concentric, equal, symmetric (2 entities then the symmetry line), midpoint (point, line), intersection (point, 2 lines), fix, pierce (point + a model edge or a segment of another sketch crossing the plane), merge (2 points). Verified: the relation was added (or the points merged) and the solved geometry satisfies it; an over-defining relation is undone; VERIFY_FAILED if SOLIDWORKS ignored it.

relation.description: horizontal | vertical | coincident | collinear | parallel | perpendicular | tangent | concentric | equal | symmetric | midpoint | intersection | fix | pierce | merge

entities.description: Entities: segments {name:'Line1'}, sketch points {at:[x,y]}; for pierce a model edge or {name:'Line1', sketch:'Sketch1'}.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_trim
tools.title: Trim sketch segment
tools.description: Trims away the piece of a segment of the open sketch at a point, up to the nearest intersections (trim to closest). Verified: the segment got shorter, was split or removed. Returns the created, changed and removed segments.

at.description: Point on the piece to remove: [x,y] sketch mm or [x,y,z] model mm.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_extend
tools.title: Extend sketch segment
tools.description: Extends a line or arc of the open sketch up to the next segment it meets. Verified: the segment got longer.

segment.description: Line or arc to extend, e.g. {name:'Line2'}.

end.description: auto (an end with a segment ahead) | start | end

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_offset
tools.title: Offset sketch segments
tools.description: Offsets segments of the open sketch by a distance. A closed loop goes outward, inward or both (a 100x60 rectangle offset 5 outward gives a 110x70 loop); an open chain goes left, right or both, seen along its first segment from start to end. Verified on the loop size or side and the new segments' distance; otherwise undone. Returns boxMm.

segments.description: Segments to offset: e.g. the 4 lines of a rectangle, or one of them with chain=true.

side.description: Closed loop: outward | inward | both. Open chain: left | right | both.

chain.description: Also offset the segments connected end to end with them.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_fillet
tools.title: Sketch fillet
tools.description: Rounds a corner of the open sketch with a tangent arc (its two segments are trimmed). The corner is given by its two segments or by the corner point. Verified: a new arc of that radius.

at.description: Or the corner point [x,y] sketch mm.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_chamfer
tools.title: Sketch chamfer
tools.description: Cuts a corner of the open sketch with a chamfer line: type equal (distanceMm on both sides), distance_distance (distanceMm along the first segment, distance2Mm along the second) or distance_angle (distanceMm along the first segment, angleDeg from it). Corner by its two segments or its point. Verified: the chamfer's ends lie at those distances (and that angle) on each segment.

distanceMm.description: Chamfer distance in mm, along the first segment for the unequal types (with 'at' the result says which segment).

at.description: Or the corner point [x,y] sketch mm.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_pattern
tools.title: Sketch pattern
tools.description: Copies entities of the open sketch in a pattern. linear: countX instances spacingXMm apart along angleDeg (0 = sketch +x), optionally countY rows spacingYMm apart at +90 deg. circular: count instances about center, evenly around a full circle (totalAngleDeg 360) or spanning a smaller angle, counter-clockwise (negative = clockwise). Counts include the seed. Verified: the copies lie at the predicted positions; otherwise undone.

countX.description: linear: instances along the first direction.

spacingXMm.description: linear: spacing along the first direction, mm.

countY.description: linear: instances along the second direction (default 1).

spacingYMm.description: linear: spacing along the second direction, mm.

angleDeg.description: linear: first direction in degrees from sketch +x (default 0).

totalAngleDeg.description: circular: 360 = full circle; less = the angle from the seed to the last instance (at most 360·(count-1)/count); negative = clockwise.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_mirror
tools.title: Sketch mirror
tools.description: Mirrors entities of the open sketch about a line or centerline of it (the copies get symmetric relations). Verified: each copy lies at the reflected position.

about.description: The mirror line or centerline, e.g. {name:'Line5'}.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_convert
tools.title: Convert entities
tools.description: Convert Entities: projects model edges (or all edges of a face) into the open sketch as segments linked to the model. Verified: new segments, with their total length compared to the edges'.

entities.description: Model edges or faces, e.g. [{type:'edge',at:[x,y,z]}] or [{id:'E3'}]; a bare {at:[x,y,z]} is an edge.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_construction_set
tools.title: Set construction geometry
tools.description: Turns segments of the open sketch into construction geometry (ignored by features) or back into regular geometry. Verified by reading the flag back.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_delete
tools.title: Delete sketch segments
tools.description: Deletes segments (or points) of the open sketch together with their relations. Verified: they are gone.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_start
tools.title: Start sketch
tools.description: Opens a new sketch on a plane ({name:'top'|'front'|'right'} or a plane's name) or on a planar face ({id:'F3'} or {at:[x,y,z]}). Returns the sketch name and its frame in model space (origin, x axis, y axis, normal), and for a face its extents in sketch coordinates. Inference snapping is off while this server draws.

on.description: Plane or planar face to sketch on.

threeD.description: Open a 3D sketch instead (points are then model [x,y,z]).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_add
tools.title: Add sketch entities
tools.description: Draws entities in the open sketch, all or nothing. Points: [x,y] sketch mm or [x,y,z] model mm (projected). Kinds and fields: line/centerline {from,to}; polyline {points,closed}; rectangle {corners:[p1,p2]} or {center,widthMm,heightMm}; circle {center,radiusMm|diameterMm}; arc {start,mid,end} or {center,radiusMm,startDeg,endDeg} (CCW); slot {from,to,widthMm}; polygon {center,sides,circumradiusMm|inradiusMm,rotationDeg}; ellipse {center,majorRadiusMm,minorRadiusMm,rotationDeg}; spline {points}; point {at}. Any kind: construction, label. Returns segment names per entity (rectangle sides named) and the contour status (closed loops are needed for extrudes).

kind.description: line | centerline | polyline | rectangle | circle | arc | slot | polygon | ellipse | spline | point | text

closed.description: polyline: close the loop (last point back to the first).

widthMm.description: rectangle (with center): width along sketch x, in mm.

heightMm.description: rectangle (with center): height along sketch y, in mm; text: the character height.

diameterMm.description: circle: diameter in mm (instead of radiusMm).

mid.description: arc (3-point form): a point on the arc between start and end.

startDeg.description: arc (center form): start angle in degrees, counter-clockwise from sketch +x.

endDeg.description: arc (center form): end angle in degrees (counter-clockwise from startDeg).

circumradiusMm.description: polygon: radius of the circumscribed circle (to the vertices), mm.

inradiusMm.description: polygon: radius of the inscribed circle (to the flats), mm.

rotationDeg.description: polygon/ellipse: rotation in degrees (polygon: first vertex angle; ellipse: major axis angle).

at.description: point: location; text: where the text starts (its lower left).

text.description: text: the characters (engrave with feature_extrude cut).

construction.description: Make the entity construction geometry (not part of profiles).

label.description: Your label for this entity; echoed in the result.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_import
tools.title: Import DXF/DWG
tools.description: A DXF or DWG drawing into a new sketch on a plane or flat face of the part (legacy 2D data, laser profiles), with the drawing's coordinates and unit; coincident ends are merged. Returns the segments by type and their extents (mm, sketch coordinates); it becomes the last sketch, so feature_extrude uses it.

on.description: Plane or flat face (default: the Front plane).

units.description: The drawing's unit: mm | cm | m | in | ft.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: sketch_finish
tools.title: Finish sketch
tools.description: Closes the open sketch. Returns its segment and relation counts, constrained status and contour status (closed/open loops, regions). The next feature tool uses this sketch by default.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: asm_part_new
tools.title: New part in assembly
tools.description: A new part in the assembly. Without face: an empty part file fixed at the assembly origin, open as the target document, so the part tools model it in assembly coordinates (doc_rebuild the assembly after). With face and depthMm: in context, the face's outline (holes too) extruded away from it (reverse: into it); it follows the face when that part changes. Verified: volume = face area × depth; lists the references.

name.description: File name of the new part.

face.description: In context: a flat face of a component, e.g. {at:[x,y,z]} (assembly mm).

reverse.description: In context: extrude into the face.

folder.description: Folder for the file (default: the assembly's).

doc.description: Assembly (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: body_save
tools.title: Save bodies as parts
tools.description: Saves bodies of a saved multibody part as part files (Save Bodies; they follow this master part), optionally with an assembly of them in place. Files: prefix + body name. Verified: each file has its body's volume; the assembly has every part and their total volume.

assembly.description: Also an assembly of them: a file name or path.

names.description: File names for the bodies, in order (default: prefix + body name).

prefix.description: File name prefix (default: the part's name and '_', none with names).

doc.description: Part (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: part_derive
tools.title: Derived part
tools.description: insert: another part's bodies into this one at its origin (linked unless breakLink). mirror: a new part mirrored about a plane or flat face, saved (default: '_mirror' added, next to this part) and opened. Verified: insert grows the volume by the inserted part's; mirror keeps it and reflects the box.

path.description: insert: the part file to insert.

plane.description: mirror: the plane or flat face, e.g. {name:'right'}.

newPath.description: mirror: where to save the new part.

breakLink.description: Don't follow later changes of the source.

doc.description: Part (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: view_screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot (inline PNG image) of the target document in a standard view, zoomed to fit, planes hidden. The user's view, display mode, visibility settings, selection and active window are restored afterwards. Use it to check shape and orientation after modeling steps.

view.description: iso | front | back | left | right | top | bottom | trimetric | dimetric | current

displayMode.description: shaded_edges | shaded | wireframe | hidden_removed | hidden_grayed | current

hidePlanes.description: Hide reference planes in the image.

file.description: Also save the PNG to this file (relative paths go under Documents\solidworks-mcp).

section.description: Cut a 3D section for the image: a plane or planar face, e.g. {name:'front'} (removed afterwards).

sectionOffsetMm.description: Section: offset from the plane, mm.

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: weldment_member
tools.title: Weldment structural member
tools.description: Weldment frame: structural members (tube, pipe, channel, angle, beam profiles) swept along the lines and arcs of a 2D or 3D sketch, with mitered or butt corners; makes the part a weldment. A wrong type or size lists the available ones. Verified: one new solid body along each segment, its length there; else rolled back. Returns each member's body and length.

type.description: Profile type, e.g. "square tube", "rectangular tube", "pipe", "c channel", "angle iron", "sb beam" (iso).

standard.description: Profile standard folder: iso (default), ansi, din, jis, …

sketch.description: Path sketch (2D or 3D); default: the open sketch, else the last finished one.

segments.description: Only these segments, e.g. ["Line1","Line3"] (sketch_info); default: every line and arc.

rotateDeg.description: Profile rotation about the path in degrees.

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.

tools.name: weldment_finish
tools.title: Weldment trim, end cap, gusset, weld bead
tools.description: Finishes a weldment's members. trim: trims or extends members (bodies) to a boundary (bodies or faces), or joins two at a corner (miter/butt1/butt2); trimmed bodies are renamed after the trim. end_cap: plates on open member ends. gusset: a triangular plate in the corner of two flat faces. bead: a weld bead (cosmetic, as weld tables count them) where two face sets meet. Verified against the geometry (plate thickness and side, the triangle, the weld's edges and length); else rolled back.

bodies.description: trim: members to trim or extend: {name:'Structural Member1[2]'} (body_list) or {at:[x,y,z]} on a face.

boundary.description: trim: where they end: bodies, or faces.

coped.description: trim: cut to the boundary's shape (coped) instead of its plane.

faces.description: end_cap: open end faces; gusset: the two faces it joins; bead: faces welded from.

offsetMm.description: end_cap: cap outline inset from the member's outer edges.

direction.description: end_cap: outward (default, beyond the end) | inward (member gets shorter) | internal (in the bore)

insetMm.description: end_cap internal: depth inside the end.

location.description: gusset: start | center (default) | end of the joint.

side.description: gusset: both (default) | inner | outer; bead: selection (default) | both | all_around

keepOnFailure.description: Keep a failed result (for diagnosis).

doc.description: Document (handle, title or path); default: the target document.
